key_notes: Key 1 (t=0.37s): Initial archival pose of teddy-bear; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=1.5s): Mid-sequence articulation of teddy-bear; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=2.73s): Peak dynamic extension of teddy-bear over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=3.97s): Follow-through and settle of teddy-bear with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of teddy-bear (0.37s..3.97s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
